official_definition: Target and attack the opposing Spirit with the lowest cost. Also, when the blocking Spirit is depleted/destroyed, discard six cards from the opposing decktop, and target the next opposing target with lowest cost to make it block. This "target attack/block" effect can't be prevented by opposing effects.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Roaring Stampede] or [Roaring Stampede: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Roaring Stampede]", "give [Roaring Stampede]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mills cards from opposing decktop to Grave.
